{{Quote|Anything else you'd like boy? Grammel's cloak of office, or maybe the Emperor's Dualities?|Halla|<ref name="SotME" />}}
A '''cloak of office''' was a piece of clothing designating that the wearer holds a particular position within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Halla]] claimed that [[Grammel]], [[Captain-Supervisor]] of [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], had a cloak of office, and that it would be very difficult to steal.<ref name="SotME" />
